title: # Iran’s President Rings School Bell as Nation Returns to In-Person Classes After Months of Online Learning
text:
# Iran’s President Rings School Bell as Nation Returns to In-Person Classes After Months of Online Learning"

"Tehran — President Masoud Pezeshkian inaugurated Iran’s new academic year on Tuesday by ringing the ceremonial school bell at a girls’ school in Tehran’s District 18 (Yaftabad neighborhood), marking a pivotal moment for a nation emerging from an extended period of remote education. The opening ceremony was attended by Education Minister Alireza Kazemi and other senior officials.
